meta.title: No NaN, Infinity or negative totals with charges and discounts
gaps: The vocabulary exposes no buyer-readable total, charge, discount, NaN, Infinity, or negative-value fields, so those figures cannot be scanned or asserted.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with two QA vendors invited, each with a submitted bid; bidding still open.
steps: As the buyer, read the event and check that the read succeeds.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that “bid count” equals 2; the read succeeds.
As the buyer, read the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder) and check that the read succeeds.
As the buyer, list the event's line items and check that the read succeeds.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the read succeeds; “bid count” equals 2; the read succeeds; the read succeeds; the read succeeds.
